notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create a Treasure token for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
